description: Production Turbopack gzip baselines for every canonical preview route after the examples were made self-contained. The checker requires exact coverage of exampleSlugs, allows the larger of 2% or 5 KiB growth per example and 5 KiB for the shared host, rejects stale builds and shared route-owned chunks, and supplements those checks with surviving WGSL source markers. ML runtimes and model files are fetched dynamically as public assets and are not attributed to route chunks.
$comment:tgeist-08: Twenty previously over-limit routes were remeasured from one Node 22 / Next 16.3.3 production build after integration of strict binding checks and the updated canary library/toolchain: gradient through air-painting, excluding optimized-black-hole and glass-fractal. The other eight route baselines and shared host retain their earlier Node 22 / Next 16.3.2 measurements. Shared library growth is intentional; this measurement does not isolate the toolchain's byte contribution or claim two-build confirmation. Growth allowances and structural checks are unchanged. previousAppsDocsBaseline remains read-only historical provenance, including examples that no longer exist.
$comment:three-tsl: three-tsl is the outlier here at ~279 KB against a 15-85 KB field, and deliberately so: it is the advanced three.js integration example, so three.js core, the TSL node system, WebGPURenderer and BloomNode are the subject of the example rather than incidental weight. Adding the second Three route made Turbopack factor 238179 B gzip of shared Three code into its own chunk; a same-build control with the former local helper measured 276833 B, so vgpu/three itself adds only 2280 B to this route. The HDRI it lights with is served from public/examples/three-tsl/sunset.exr instead of the inlined @pmndrs/assets data URI, which keeps ~147 KB of base64 out of this number. Treat a regression against this baseline the same as any other; do not treat the baseline itself as a precedent for non-three examples.
$comment:tsl-exports: The focused tslExports route is 239570 B gzip: a 238179 B shared Three/TSL/WebGPURenderer chunk plus 1391 B of route-owned example code. Renaming the route shortened both the adapter and former-local-helper builds by 4 B, so the same-build control remains a 2285 B adapter delta. Keep this route intentionally small even though the framework it demonstrates dominates its transfer size.
$comment:glass-sculpture: Measured at 72804 B gzip from the current canary production build on Node 22.21.1; the external proposal's provisional 78000 B value was not carried forward.
$comment:matcap: Measured at 70640 B gzip from the current canary production build on Node 22.21.1 / Next 16.3.3 after the reviewed lifecycle and vertex-shading refinements.
$comment:video-to-texture: Measured at 68829 B gzip from the current canary production build on Node 22.21.1 / Next 16.3.3 after lifecycle, media-provenance, and current texture-API integration.

previousAppsDocsBaseline.$comment: Read-only provenance, not used by check-example-bundles.mjs: the numbers this file carried in apps/docs, so the before/after table can be regenerated from the repo alone. apps/docs keeps its own copy of this file, unmodified, until cutover (TGEIST-15).

$comment:spiral-galaxy: Measured at 86662 B gzip on Node 22.21.1 against canary c290dd32, with batched compute/render submission, compute prewarming, unchanged shader output, and a static vgpu import inside the lazy-loaded example.
$comment:spiral-galaxy-shared-chunks: Adding Spiral Galaxy changes Turbopack chunk factoring: an isolated clean-canary control at 7d51e9db measures Atmosphere at 111457 B gzip, versus 111604 B with this example, using the same Node 22.21.1 and lockfile. Increase only Atmosphere's baseline by the measured 147 B delta (106391 to 106538), preserving its existing 54 B remaining allowance; its source and all growth rules remain unchanged. The updated c290dd32 candidate reproduces the same 111604 B measurement.
$comment:liquid-layout: Measured at 137375 B gzip from a production build of canary cdf24a18 plus this example on Node 22.21.1 / Next 16.3.3. Motion's React layer (layout projection, layoutId, drag, AnimatePresence) is the largest route-owned chunk at 45172 B; the example code and WGSL add 25740 B, and the rest is the two chunks every route loads (49880 B, including the vgpu runtime) plus the 16583 B lil-gui/vgpu chunk shared with Glass Sculpture and Spiral Galaxy.
$comment:liquid-layout-shared-chunks: Adding Liquid Layout changes Turbopack chunk factoring: Spiral Galaxy's raw bytes stay at 272348 B, but its lil-gui code moves into the lil-gui/vgpu chunk that Glass Sculpture already loads, now shared by all three lil-gui routes. A same-machine control of the same tree with this example removed measures Spiral Galaxy at 86777 B gzip, versus 87311 B with it, on the same Node 22.21.1 and lockfile. Increase only Spiral Galaxy's baseline by the measured 534 B delta (86662 to 87196); its source and all growth rules remain unchanged. Atmosphere measures the same 111816 B in both local builds, so this example does not move it (canary CI run 36044722520 measures it at 111628 B).
$comment:spring-choreography: Measured at 117005 B gzip from a production build of this branch (canary cdf24a18 plus Liquid Layout and this example) on Node 22.21.1 / Next 16.3.3. The route loads no React Motion: vanilla Motion's core (animate, spring, stagger, frame) is a 24697 B chunk shared with Liquid Layout, and springValue with the vgpu compute runtime adds 3471 B. The example code and six WGSL modules are 22374 B; the rest is the two chunks every route loads (49880 B, including the vgpu runtime) and the 16583 B lil-gui/vgpu chunk shared with Glass Sculpture, Spiral Galaxy and Liquid Layout.
$comment:spring-choreography-shared-chun: Adding Spring Choreography changes Turbopack chunk factoring for Liquid Layout: Motion's core leaves its 45172 B Motion chunk for the new 24697 B chunk shared by both routes, leaving 23010 B of React Motion, and its route-owned code measures 26096 B instead of 25740 B. Liquid Layout therefore reads 140266 B gzip, versus the 137375 B recorded when it was added to the same tree without this example, with the every-route (49880 B) and lil-gui/vgpu (16583 B) chunks byte-identical in both builds. That is within its 142495 B limit, so its baseline is unchanged; the 2891 B is factoring, not Liquid Layout growth. No other route moves: Glass Sculpture matches canary CI run 36044722520 exactly (73289 B), Spiral Galaxy still measures 87311 B, and Atmosphere still reads the same 111816 B here (111628 B in that CI run).
